test_fill_format_with_prompt: test the fill_format_with_prompt function to replace a placeholder in a prompt format with actual prompt text
test_vanilla_prompting: test the vanilla_prompting function to generate a response from a model using a prompt with temperature 0
test_naive_factuality_prompt: test the naive_factuality_prompt function to generate a factually accurate response by wrapping the prompt with factuality instructions
test_punt_if_unsure: test the punt_if_unsure function to detect when a model admits it does not know an answer and return an is_idk flag
test_respond: test the respond dispatcher function to route prompts to different response methods like vanilla_prompting, naive_factuality_prompt, or punt_if_unsure
